trades.name: Electrician
trades.description: Install, maintain, and repair electrical systems in homes, factories, and commercial buildings.
trades.description_hi: घरों, कारखानों और व्यावसायिक इमारतों में विद्युत प्रणालियों को स्थापित करना, बनाए रखना और मरम्मत करना।

parental_concerns_addressed.income: Electricians earn ₹10,000-₹55,000/month with high self-employment potential
parental_concerns_addressed.safety: Standard safety gear and training protocols ensure safe work practices
parental_concerns_addressed.social_status: Electricians are highly respected in communities as essential service providers
parental_concerns_addressed.growth: NSQF pathway allows progression to Electrical Supervisor and Contractor roles
parental_concerns_addressed.female_safety: Growing opportunities in domestic and commercial sectors with safe indoor environments

trades.name: Plumber
trades.description: Install and repair pipes, fittings, and fixtures for water supply and sanitation systems.
trades.description_hi: जल आपूर्ति और स्वच्छता प्रणालियों के लिए पाइप, फिटिंग और जुड़नार स्थापित करना और मरम्मत करना।

parental_concerns_addressed.income: Plumbers earn ₹8,000-₹45,000/month with very high self-employment potential in urban areas
parental_concerns_addressed.safety: Indoor work with standard safety protocols; low physical risk
parental_concerns_addressed.social_status: Critical infrastructure trade with high community respect and consistent demand
parental_concerns_addressed.growth: Smart water management and green building sector creating new opportunities
parental_concerns_addressed.female_safety: Growing demand for female plumbers in household sector

trades.name: Beauty & Wellness Technician
trades.description: Provide beauty and wellness services including hair care, skin care, and grooming.
trades.description_hi: बाल देखभाल, त्वचा देखभाल और सौंदर्य सेवाएं प्रदान करना।

parental_concerns_addressed.income: Beauty professionals earn ₹6,000-₹60,000/month with very high salon ownership potential
parental_concerns_addressed.safety: Completely safe indoor work environment; no heavy machinery or outdoor risk
parental_concerns_addressed.social_status: Growing industry with celebrity associations; respectable profession
parental_concerns_addressed.growth: ₹90,000 crore industry growing at 30% per year; massive demand post-COVID
parental_concerns_addressed.female_safety: Predominantly female workforce with safe, professional indoor work environment

trades.name: Computer Operator & Programming Assistant
trades.description: Data entry, computer operations, basic programming, and office automation tasks.
trades.description_hi: डेटा एंट्री, कंप्यूटर ऑपरेशन, बुनियादी प्रोग्रामिंग और ऑफिस ऑटोमेशन कार्य।

parental_concerns_addressed.income: IT sector offers ₹8,000-₹70,000/month with fastest salary growth of any sector
parental_concerns_addressed.social_status: IT professionals are highly respected; considered equivalent to degree holders in terms of status
parental_concerns_addressed.growth: India's IT sector employs 5+ million; massive government digital push creating new roles
parental_concerns_addressed.female_safety: Safe office environment with 45% female workforce; best sector for women's safety and growth

trades.name: Welder
trades.description: Join metal parts using welding equipment in manufacturing, construction and automotive sectors.
trades.description_hi: विनिर्माण, निर्माण और ऑटोमोटिव क्षेत्रों में वेल्डिंग उपकरण का उपयोग करके धातु के हिस्सों को जोड़ना।

parental_concerns_addressed.income: Welders earn ₹9,000-₹50,000/month; certified welders can work in Gulf countries earning ₹60,000-₹1,20,000/month
parental_concerns_addressed.safety: Full protective gear provided; modern welding is safer than traditional methods
parental_concerns_addressed.social_status: Core manufacturing skill with strong respect in industrial communities
parental_concerns_addressed.growth: PLI scheme boosting Indian manufacturing; massive demand from defense and infrastructure
parental_concerns_addressed.female_safety: Growing opportunities in precision welding and quality control roles for women

trades.name: General Duty Assistant (Healthcare)
trades.description: Provide basic patient care, assist medical staff, and support hospital operations.
trades.description_hi: बुनियादी रोगी देखभाल प्रदान करना, चिकित्सा कर्मियों की सहायता करना और अस्पताल संचालन में सहायता करना।

parental_concerns_addressed.income: Healthcare workers earn ₹8,000-₹40,000/month; overseas opportunities in Gulf and Europe pay ₹80,000-₹2,00,000/month
parental_concerns_addressed.safety: Safe, dignified work in hospitals with clear protocols and protective equipment
parental_concerns_addressed.social_status: Healthcare is among the most respected professions in Indian society
parental_concerns_addressed.growth: Ayushman Bharat and health infrastructure expansion creating millions of new jobs
parental_concerns_addressed.female_safety: 70% female workforce; extremely safe working environment in regulated hospital settings

trades.name: Sewing Technology / Dress Making
trades.description: Sewing, stitching, embroidery, garment construction and textile operations.
trades.description_hi: सिलाई, कढ़ाई, परिधान निर्माण और वस्त्र संचालन।

parental_concerns_addressed.income: Skilled tailors/designers earn ₹6,000-₹45,000/month; boutique owners can earn ₹50,000+
parental_concerns_addressed.safety: Completely safe home-based work possible; ideal for women who prefer working from home
parental_concerns_addressed.social_status: Fashion design is trendy and respected; helps preserve traditional crafts
parental_concerns_addressed.growth: India's textile export target of $100 billion creating massive demand for skilled workers
parental_concerns_addressed.female_safety: Work from home possible; predominantly female-friendly trade with flexible hours

trades.name: Automobile Service Technician
trades.description: Service, diagnose, and repair automobiles including engines, brakes, and electrical systems.
trades.description_hi: इंजन, ब्रेक और विद्युत प्रणालियों सहित ऑटोमोबाइल की सर्विस, निदान और मरम्मत करना।

parental_concerns_addressed.income: Auto technicians earn ₹9,000-₹55,000/month; EV revolution creating premium new roles
parental_concerns_addressed.safety: Modern garages with lifts and safety equipment; clean working conditions
parental_concerns_addressed.social_status: As cars become essential, auto technicians are highly valued professionals
parental_concerns_addressed.growth: Electric vehicle revolution creating massive demand for upskilled technicians
parental_concerns_addressed.female_safety: Service advisor and quality control roles ideal for women in the automotive sector

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
schemes.description: Free skill training with certification and monetary rewards for completion

schemes.name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
schemes.name_hi: दीन दयाल उपाध्याय ग्रामीण कौशल्या योजना
schemes.description: Skill training for rural youth with guaranteed job placement
schemes.eligibility: Rural youth aged 15-35 years from poor families

schemes.name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
schemes.description: Learn while you earn through apprenticeship with top companies
